description: Links a conversation to a contact, as the inbox's Link to a contact does: if the contact already has a one-to-one thread, it is folded into this one, and an email thread's address is saved to the contact. Sergio learns the correction for later emails. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: link_conversation_to_client
title: Link a conversation to a contact
